Subject: Stumpf 
 
Just so we’re all on the same page with Stumpf/Bosio stuff.

Separate story has been published that Stumpf is not familiar with nickname. I’ve added the background and stuff from the Nightengale story. I’d push that in the AM since we got it so late. But as of at least right now, it’s still an exclusive.
As for the Anthony story from earlier, I’ve updated the parts where “it was unclear” to add the Strumf comments.
I think that’s it. For now. Phew.
Deputy Sports Editor, Detroit Free Press
